resources.string: Choose a background, rotate the 14 bundled Scenes, or use your own theme pictures. Changes apply when you return Home.
Smoother gradients with less banding. Uses more memory than standard wallpaper color.
The sky follows your city’s sunrise and sunset. Race information appears near a race weekend. City search uses Open-Meteo; calendar updates use Jolpica.
Could not load the data. Your saved choices and calendar are unchanged. Please try again.
No matching cities found. Try adding the country.
Shows the drifting clock after Home is left untouched. It never interrupts a show or another app. Any key returns to Home.
Choose an app to change its name, launch destination or artwork. These choices survive theme changes.
An action offered by this app, such as its program guide. Leave blank to open the app normally.
This app does not offer that action.
Could not read this image. Choose a smaller image under 8 MB.
This TV has no image picker installed. Install a file manager that supports choosing images, then try again.
Assign an app to a remote button. Enable Remote button helper in Accessibility for buttons to work from other apps. Home, Back, volume and navigation buttons stay reserved.
Opens apps assigned to remote buttons and the TV input switcher. Only remote key presses are handled; screen content is not read.
Press the remote button you want to assign. Press Back to cancel.
Show unfinished movies and episodes from the app selected in the dock. Apps with no unfinished items show no row. Up selects a show; Down returns to your apps.
Allow TV listings access to show Continue Watching from your apps.
This item is no longer available. Open its app to continue watching.
